svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1397 commits across five public projects, 77 active days, peak 207 commits per day. 2026-07-21 through 2026-10-12 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-12T19:24:43.395Z.
